Elder Dale G. Renlund once compared the priesthood to a rocket that carries a payload. Broadly speaking, “the opportunity to benefit from the Savior’s atoning power” is the “payload” that the priesthood “rocket” delivers (see “The Priesthood and the Savior’s Atoning Power,”Liahona, Nov. 2017, 64–65).
